With NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, the difference in fees can be substantial, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings. This post will breakdown how to leverage GitHub Pages for a free digital product store without relying on traditional payment platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that allows you to create websites directly from a GitHub repository. By utilizing GitHub Pages for your digital product store, you eliminate reliance on conventional payment processors. This is particularly crucial for creators in regions facing financial isolation, as it allows for complete ownership of their infrastructure without the burden of platform fees. When paired with NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency payments seamlessly, enabling broader access to your products. This approach not only enhances the creator's control over their business but also ensures a direct connection with their audience without intermediaries.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind a GitHub Pages store is straightforward yet powerful. At its core, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform, providing a free and reliable way to display your products. You can utilize Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, handling transactions and order fulfillment efficiently. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the payment in over 300 cryptocurrencies, confirming the transaction on-chain. This entire setup ensures that you retain full ownership of your data and products, with no hidden fees or subscriptions. The result is a lean, efficient digital storefront that operates independently of traditional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are not an option. Whether you are selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or digital assets, this setup offers a solution that prioritizes sovereignty and cost efficiency. By deploying a GitHub Pages store, you gain the ability to offer your products directly to customers without incurring hefty fees that can cut into your profits. This is especially beneficial for creators in Nigeria, Pakistan, and other regions where access to traditional payment solutions is limited or fraught with challenges. It empowers creators to monetize their work and reach a global audience.
Retain 99.5% of your sales with NOWPayments compared to 90% with Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of your GitHub Pages digital store hinges on several key components working in harmony. First, GitHub Pages provides a free hosting platform for your website. Next, backend logic is managed via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, allowing for automation of order processing and delivery. For payment processing, NOWPayments integrates seamlessly, enabling you to accept cryptocurrency payments without the need for extensive KYC procedures. Finally, utilizing services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that your digital products are delivered instantly. Together, these components create a robust infrastructure that operates independently of traditional payment systems.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your GitHub Pages store, follow these steps: First, set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your store. Next, upload your product files and configure your website using GitHub Pages. Then, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage your order logic. Afterward, set up NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you choose recommended networks for low fees. Finally, promote your store and products to attract customers. For an all-in-one solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which provides all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Deploy a fully operational online store in just 48 hours.

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you have all the tools necessary for successful online sales.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
